\chapter{City, School, and Road}
\label{ch:gu-city-school-road}
\hlchaptermodality{26}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can hear, say, read, and write city, school, and road in Gujarati.}

Each place enters through sound and meaning before familiar script carries reading and writing; the checkpoint scores all four skills separately.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[shahar]{\gu{શહેર} — hear city first}

\label{lesson:GU-C22-hear-shahar}



\begin{quote}
Listen twice: \textbf{shahar}. It means \textbf{city}. Hold only the sound and meaning; the Gujarati spelling waits for the next small step.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to the city picture when you hear \emph{shahar}, then say \emph{shahar} once from the English cue.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/city}{Cambridge: city}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[shahar]{\gu{શહેર} — city on the page}

\label{lesson:GU-C22-shahar}



\begin{quote}
Say \emph{shahar} from \textbf{city}, then look: \textbf{\gu{શહેર}} — \emph{shahar} — city.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Trace \textbf{\gu{શહેર}} once, then copy it once while saying \emph{shahar}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/city}{Cambridge: city}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[shāḷā]{\gu{શાળા} — hear school first}

\label{lesson:GU-C22-hear-shaalaa}



\begin{quote}
Listen twice: \textbf{shāḷā}. It means \textbf{school}. Keep the two long \emph{ā} sounds and the meaning together; ignore the printed form for now.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Choose the school picture when you hear \emph{shāḷā}, then say the word once.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/school}{Cambridge: school}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[shāḷā]{\gu{શાળા} — school on the page}

\label{lesson:GU-C22-shaalaa}



\begin{quote}
Before looking below, write \textbf{city} in Gujarati from memory. Now check only that answer: \textbf{\gu{શહેર}}. Then say \emph{shāḷā} from \textbf{school}, and look: \textbf{\gu{શાળા}} — \emph{shāḷā} — school.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Study \textbf{\gu{શાળા}} for five seconds, cover it, and write it once. Uncover and repair only the sign that differs.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/school}{Cambridge: school}.
\end{tcolorbox}
